records.jp: そういえば……みんな、<CR>リフナビってちゃんと働いてた？
records.en_original: That reminds me, did you all work with ReSource?
records.en_auxiliary: That reminds me, did you all work with ReSource?
records.en: That reminds me... everyone,<CR>was ReSource working properly?

records.jp: え？　うーん……<CR>働いてた、と言えば働いてたけど
records.en_original: Hm? I guess you could say that...
records.en_auxiliary: Hm? I guess you could say that...
records.en: Huh? Hmm...<CR>I suppose you could say it was working.

records.jp: でも、あれも詩ちゃんのクラックの時から<CR>お返事してくれなくなっちゃったんだよね
records.en_original: But it stopped responding ever since Uta's Crack.
records.en_auxiliary: But it stopped responding ever since Uta's Crack.
records.en: But it stopped answering us<CR>after Uta-chan's Crack.

records.jp: リフナビがどうしたの？
records.en_original: What happened to it?
records.en_auxiliary: What happened to it?
records.en: What happened to it?

records.jp: リフナビは、ライムが起きた時点で<CR>役目を終えたわけなんだけど――
records.en_original: ReSource finished serving its purpose when I woke up.
records.en_auxiliary: ReSource finished serving its purpose when I woke up.
records.en: ReSource completed its role<CR>the moment Lime woke up, but—

records.jp: アレ、ライムなんだよね
records.en_original: It's me, after all.
records.en_auxiliary: It's me, after all.
records.en: That thing is Lime, you know.

records.jp: えええええええええええええええ！？！？
records.en_original: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!?!
records.en_auxiliary: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!?!
records.en: Whaaaaaaaaaaaaat?!?!

records.jp: 正確に言うと、ライムの想いを一部切り離して作った、<CR>別人格みたいなものなんだけどね
records.en_original: To be specific, she's like a second personality that I created by detaching some of my emotions.
records.en_auxiliary: To be specific, she's like a second personality that I created by detaching some of my emotions.
records.en: More precisely, it is like a separate personality<CR>created by splitting off part of Lime's feelings.

records.jp: そ、そうだったんですか！？
records.en_original: R-really?!
records.en_auxiliary: R-really?!
records.en: R-really?!

records.jp: ああでも、「クマのぬいぐるみ」を作れって<CR>言ってきたのもリフナビだった……
records.en_original: Ahh, but come to think of it, ReSource was the one who told us to make that teddy bear...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, but come to think of it, ReSource was the one who told us to make that teddy bear...
records.en: Oh, but ReSource was also the one<CR>who told us to make the teddy bear...

records.jp: 世界の仕組みを知ってるのも、<CR>ライムさんなら納得か……
records.en_original: It does make sense that Lime would know more about this world than anybody else...
records.en_auxiliary: It does make sense that Lime would know more about this world than anybody else...
records.en: If it was Lime-san,<CR>that explains why it knew how the world worked...

records.jp: ●カット
●カット
●カット
●カット
本来は、眠ったままみんなに情報を<CR>伝えるために生み出した存在だったけど……
records.en_original: Originally, I created it to pass on information to everyone while I slept.
records.en_auxiliary: Originally, I created it to pass on information to everyone while I slept.
records.en: Originally, Lime created it to convey information to everyone<CR>while Lime remained asleep, but...

records.jp: クラックでダメージを受けて機能停止して、<CR>復旧にかなり時間がかかっちゃった
records.en_original: But it was damaged in the Crack and took a long time to recover.
records.en_auxiliary: But it was damaged in the Crack and took a long time to recover.
records.en: It was damaged by the Crack and stopped functioning,<CR>so restoring it took quite a long time.

records.jp: もう、初耳だよ！<CR>言っといてよそういうことは！
records.en_original: Why didn't you tell me?! This is the first I'm hearing of this!
records.en_auxiliary: Why didn't you tell me?! This is the first I'm hearing of this!
records.en: Come on, this is the first Yuzu has heard of it!<CR>You should have told Yuzu!

records.jp: 眠ってる間に思いついたんだもん。<CR>仕方ないじゃん
records.en_original: I came up with the idea while I was sleeping. How was I supposed to tell you?
records.en_auxiliary: I came up with the idea while I was sleeping. How was I supposed to tell you?
records.en: Lime thought of it while asleep.<CR>There was no way to tell Yuzu.

records.jp: あはは……
records.en_original: Ahaha...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha...
records.en: Ahaha...

records.jp: まあとにかく、そうやってライムは<CR>いろいろ情報を集めたり、伝えたりしてたの
records.en_original: In any case, that's how I was able to gather and spread different kinds of information.
records.en_auxiliary: In any case, that's how I was able to gather and spread different kinds of information.
records.en: In any case, that was how Lime<CR>gathered and conveyed all sorts of information.

records.jp: 本当に、簡単なやりとりしかできなかったけどね。<CR>だから機能は絞らざるを得なかった
records.en_original: ReSource was only capable of simple exchanges though. That's why I had to narrow down the functions.
records.en_auxiliary: ReSource was only capable of simple exchanges though. That's why I had to narrow down the functions.
records.en: It could only handle very simple exchanges.<CR>That was why Lime had to limit its functions.

records.jp: 変なこと聞いても答えてくれないのって、<CR>そういうことだったのか……
records.en_original: That explains why she wouldn't answer some of our questions...
records.en_auxiliary: That explains why she wouldn't answer some of our questions...
records.en: So that was why it would not answer<CR>when we asked strange questions...

records.jp: 咄嗟に思いついたことだったけど、<CR>ちゃんと役目を果たしてくれてよかったよ
records.en_original: It was a spur-of-the-moment idea, but I'm glad it did its job.
records.en_auxiliary: It was a spur-of-the-moment idea, but I'm glad it did its job.
records.en: It was a spur-of-the-moment idea,<CR>but Lime is glad it fulfilled its role.

records.jp: 役目を果たした……ってことは、<CR>もうお話はできないのかな……？
records.en_original: Did its job... Does that mean we can't talk to it anymore?
records.en_auxiliary: Did its job... Does that mean we can't talk to it anymore?
records.en: Fulfilled its role...?<CR>Does that mean we can't talk to it anymore...?

records.jp: そうだね。<CR>切り離した分の想いは使い果たしちゃったから
records.en_original: That's right, all the emotions used to create it have been used up.
records.en_auxiliary: That's right, all the emotions used to create it have been used up.
records.en: Correct.<CR>The feelings Lime separated off have been used up.

records.jp: 話せないって言われると、<CR>ちょっと寂しく感じるね……
records.en_original: That's kind of sad...
records.en_auxiliary: That's kind of sad...
records.en: Being told we can't talk anymore<CR>does feel a little lonely...

records.jp: え？　そんな恋しくなるようなやつだった……？
records.en_original: Huh? You're really gonna miss it that much...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? You're really gonna miss it that much...?
records.en: Huh? You're really gonna miss it that much...?

records.jp: あいつはいい性格してたよ、本当に
records.en_original: It had a really nice personality.
records.en_auxiliary: It had a really nice personality.
records.en: It really had quite the personality.

records.jp: え……？　ちょ、ちょっと待って。<CR>リフナビって、何言ってたの……？
records.en_original: W-wait a minute! What exactly did ReSource say...?
records.en_auxiliary: W-wait a minute! What exactly did ReSource say...?
records.en: Huh...? W-wait a moment.<CR>What did ReSource say...?

records.jp: ライム、知らないの？
records.en_original: You don't know, Lime?
records.en_auxiliary: You don't know, Lime?
records.en: You don't know, Lime?

records.jp: う、うん。もとはライムの想いとはいえ、<CR>切り離しちゃったから……何を言ったかまでは……
records.en_original: N-no. I may have created it, but the feelings I used aren't a part of me anymore, so...
records.en_auxiliary: N-no. I may have created it, but the feelings I used aren't a part of me anymore, so...
records.en: Y-yes. They were originally Lime's feelings,<CR>but Lime separated them... so Lime does not know exactly what it said...

records.jp: あー、えっとですね……<CR>リフナビって、こんな感じなんだけど……
records.en_original: Ahh, well in that case, let me introduce you to ReSource...
records.en_auxiliary: Ahh, well in that case, let me introduce you to ReSource...
records.en: Uh, well...<CR>ReSource was like this...

records.en_original: ....Who's that?
records.en_auxiliary: ....Who's that?
records.en: ...Who is that?

records.jp: ライムでしょ？
records.en_original: It's you, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: It's you, isn't it?
records.en: It's you, isn't it?

records.jp: い、いやそうなんだけどっ！！<CR>なんでこんなにハッピーな性格になっちゃってるの！？
records.en_original: W-well, yeah, but why is it so peppy?
records.en_auxiliary: W-well, yeah, but why is it so peppy?
records.en: W-well, yes, but!!<CR>Why did it end up with such a happy personality?!

records.jp: こっちが聞きたいけどね……
records.en_original: That's what we want to know...
records.en_auxiliary: That's what we want to know...
records.en: That's what we want to know...

records.jp: 実はライムの心の中にもこういう<CR>ハッピーな人格があるんでしょ
records.en_original: I bet that the truth is Lime is just as peppy inside as ReSource.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet that the truth is Lime is just as peppy inside as ReSource.
records.en: Maybe Lime secretly has<CR>a peppy side like that too.

records.jp: そ、そんなわけない！<CR>ライムはもっと、こう……知的な感じだし！
records.en_original: Th-that's not true! I'm more of an...intellectual type.
records.en_auxiliary: Th-that's not true! I'm more of an...intellectual type.
records.en: Th-that's not true!<CR>Lime is more... intellectual!

records.jp: えぇ？　どこが知的な感じなの？
records.en_original: Really? How so?
records.en_auxiliary: Really? How so?
records.en: Really? How so?

records.jp: た、たくさんあるでしょ！　えっと、ほら……
records.en_original: L-lot of reasons! Umm...for example...
records.en_auxiliary: L-lot of reasons! Umm...for example...
records.en: Th-there are many examples! Um, well...

records.jp: ダメだ、記憶は全部失くしてるんだった…………
records.en_original: Ah, it's no good. I forgot that I forgot all my memories...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah, it's no good. I forgot that I forgot all my memories...
records.en: No good. Lime had forgotten that all her memories were gone...

records.jp: あー！　もう！<CR>ここから先はモンスターも出るんだよ！
records.en_original: Hey! We're gonna have demons to deal with soon, you know?!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey! We're gonna have demons to deal with soon, you know?!
records.en: Ah! Enough!<CR>There will be monsters from here onward!

records.jp: もっとみんな気を引き締めていかないと！
records.en_original: We all have to stay alert!
records.en_auxiliary: We all have to stay alert!
records.en: We all have to stay alert!

records.jp: あはは、分かってるって
records.en_original: Ahaha, we know, we know.
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, we know, we know.
records.en: Ahaha, we know, we know.

records.jp: ほんとに分かってる！？
records.en_original: Do you really?!
records.en_auxiliary: Do you really?!
records.en: Do you really?!

records.jp: ふふっ、どんな状況でも気を張り詰めすぎると<CR>疲れちゃいますからね
records.en_original: Hehe, no point in exhausting yourself by trying to be alert at all times.
records.en_auxiliary: Hehe, no point in exhausting yourself by trying to be alert at all times.
records.en: Hehe. No matter the situation, remaining too tense<CR>will only exhaust you.

records.jp: うん！　きっと私たちには<CR>これくらいがちょうどいいよ
records.en_original: Yeah! This is just right for us.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah! This is just right for us.
records.en: Yeah! This level of tension<CR>is probably just right for us.
